We take a look at what works out of the box, how to set up TDP control up to 40W using SimpleDeckyTDP, and how the AMD Ryzen AI Z2 Extreme and 7.4-inch 120Hz Nebula OLED display perform across AAA and indie games. Plus, we break down early 80Wh battery life benchmarks at 6W, 17W, and 25W TDP
